---
title: "check-lab-exposition.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, blocking check that flags expository content added to a lab page.
A lab applies what the exposition pages teach,
and introduces no new definitions or results
(Ezra, 2026-11-19; psw's rule
[Keep expository content out of labs](https://morrison-lab.github.io/psw/chapters/teaching.html#keep-expository-content-out-of-labs)).

A lab page is a tracked file that the `pages` pathspecs match
(default `*-lab.qmd`).
Its content is the page and every file it pulls in through `{{< include >}}`,
followed transitively.
An include target resolves against the lab page's directory,
as Quarto resolves nested includes,
and then against the including file's directory.
An escaped include (`{{</* include ... */>}}`) is not followed,
because Quarto does not expand it.

Within a lab page's content, the check flags:

- the opening fence of a div whose id has one of the `prefixes`
  (default `def thm lem prp cor cnj rem`), as in `::: {#def-foo}`;
- an include line whose target, followed transitively, holds such a div.

A div or include is exempt when its opening line,
or one of the three lines after it,
holds `<!-- lab-exposition-ok: reason -->` with a non-empty reason.
Use `paths-ignore` to exempt whole paths, such as an outtakes directory.
No check can tell an explanation from an instruction,
so prose exposition outside a div is left to the writer and the reviewer.

## Scope

Only a line that a pull request adds is reported,
so the labs that already carry exposition are not reflagged on every PR.
An added line whose exact text was also deleted in the same diff
counts as moved rather than new.

With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning instead of scanning the whole tree.
Set `whole-tree: true` to scan every lab page on purpose,
which lists the labs that break the rule.
Every run prints how many lab pages, files and exposition divs it examined.

## Inputs

| Input          | Type    | Default       | Description |
| -------------- | ------- | ------------- | ----------- |
| `pages`        | string  | `'*-lab.qmd'` | Space-separated git pathspecs of the lab pages (recursive by default). |
| `prefixes`     | string  | `'def thm lem prp cor cnj rem'` | Space-separated div-id prefixes that count as exposition. |
| `paths-ignore` | string  | `''`          | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns (relative paths) to skip, as lab pages and as included files. Supports `*`, `?` and recursive `**`. |
| `fail`         | boolean | `true`        | Fail the workflow when a lab page gains exposition. Set `false` for warning annotations only. |
| `whole-tree`   | boolean | `false`       | Scan every lab page in full instead of only a PR's added lines. |
| `python-version` | string | `'3.x'`      | Python version to set up. |
| `runs-on` | string | empty (`CI_RUNNER` variable, else `ubuntu-latest`) | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it ([#1167](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167)). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/check-lab-exposition.yml in your repo.
# Diff-scoped check: flags a definition, result or remark div that a PR adds to
# a lab page (or to a file a lab page includes). Move it to the exposition page
# and link it from the lab, or add <!-- lab-exposition-ok: reason -->.
# Blocking by default.
# Only contents:read is needed (the default), so no permissions block is required.
name: Check lab exposition

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-lab-exposition.yml@v3
    # with:
    #   pages: 'chapters/*-lab.qmd'            # pathspecs of the lab pages
    #   paths-ignore: 'chapters/outtakes/**'   # skip known-noisy paths
    #   fail: true                             # set false to warn only (defaults to true)
    #   whole-tree: true                       # list every lab that breaks the rule
```

See
[`examples/check-lab-exposition.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-lab-exposition.yml)
for the full caller stub.
